To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the phenomenon of enhancement of photosynthetic oxygen evolution by isolated chloroplasts is governed by the supply and/or concentration of ATP, and is not related to Mg ++ or the protein factor of the PPNR.

enhancement in isolated chloro-plasts is not a general phenomenon, and when it occurs it is due to the supply of ATP and is not due to Mg ++ or to the replacement of ferredoxin with a crude preparation of proteins.
enhancement of oxygen evolution in isolated chloroplast is governed by ATP supply.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: 1) the effect of ATP and AMP on photosynthetic enhancement; 2) enhancement in the H ₂O → NADP system; 3) factors affecting the enhancement of photosynthesis in isolated chloroplast preparations.
the mechanism of enhancement in isolated chloro-plasts.
the following questions: (i) What factors influence photosynthetic enhancement of the H 2O → NADP reac tion?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
photosynthetic enhancement of NADP reductase is a complex phenomenon that is not yet fully understood.

enhancement in the H 0 → NADP and H 2 O→ NADPH reactions by chloroplasts is not governed by the presence or absence of Mg ++ or the presence or absence or the nature of the electron acceptor, but is governed by the supply and/or the utilization of ATP.
the enhancement phenomenon in the H 20 → NADP system is a function of the ATP supply.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the enhancement of oxygen evolution and of NADP photoreduction is due to an ATP-dependent mechanism.
enhancement is governed by the supply and utilization of ATP and that a protein factor present in PPNR and isolated from it is required for enhancement.
enhancement is not an inherent feature of the chloroplast photosynthetic system, but that it occurs as a result of the presence of a factor(s) in the PPNR fraction which induces enhancement.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the phenomenon of photosynthetic enhancement can occur without ATP but that ATP is required to abolish enhancement.
the enhancement of photosynthesis in isolated chloroplast is a function of the ATP supply.
the enhancement of oxygen evolution and the enhancement of NADP photoreduction by isolated chloroplasts are not related phenomena.
